verdict.rationale: cubic is a code-review SaaS, so shipping official SDKs is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence pack never mentions any SDK or client library. The Analytics API, MCP server and CLI are different capabilities, not official SDKs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404s, so no generated clients are evidenced either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
